intro: Across cryptocurrency, finance, and technology, five articles tagged ClickFix span 2026-04-10 to 2026-09-17. AMOS Stealer, ClickFix, and Lazarus Group appear among the top threat actors tracked in this coverage. Asia, Europe, and North america rank among the most affected regions. The severity mix comprises three high-severity items and one medium-severity item. These five articles examine activity tied to the listed actors across the affected sectors and regions during the stated date range.
